name: Microhydrodynamics and its Applications in Biological Systems
description: Recap of vectors and tensors and governing equation of fluid mechanics; vector harmonics of rigid particles, drops and bubbles; fundamental solution of the Stokes equations in unbounded domain; multipole expansion; suspension rheology; reciprocal theorem; inertial correction to creeping flow problems; hydrodynamic interaction - method of reflection; fundamental solution of Stokes equation near plane boundary - method of images; slender body theory; models for locomotion of microscopic swimmers; collective hydrodynamics in swimmer suspensions; basics of boundary integral equations.
